LanguageData.RC_ManualOnly: Select a faction, strategy and arrival mode, then press Check. No periodic raid calculations run. The game pauses while this tab is open.
LanguageData.RC_Limits: Conditional composition examples, not the next scheduled raid. Event randomness, landing positions, equipment and cluster buildings are not predicted.
LanguageData.RC_ContextChanged: The map or game changed. These results belong to the captured map; press Check to calculate again.
LanguageData.RC_ConditionsChanged: The selection changed. Results still describe the conditions printed below. Press Check to update them.
LanguageData.RC_Ready: No calculation has run. Press Check when you want to inspect the current raid composition.
LanguageData.RC_Points: Current base threat points: {0:0.##} (event-specific random scaling excluded)
LanguageData.RC_Range: Observed enemy count: minimum {0}, median {1:0.#}, maximum {2}. These are sample observations, not theoretical bounds.
LanguageData.RC_Aggregate: Enemy kinds across successful samples (averages may be fractional):
LanguageData.RC_Example: Example {0}: {1} enemies | adjusted raid budget {2:0.##} | summed base PawnKind combat power {3:0.##}
LanguageData.RC_Error_Points: Threat points must be finite and positive.
LanguageData.RC_Error_TooMany: The 10,000-kind-entry safety limit was exceeded. No partial composition was counted.
LanguageData.RC_Error_PawnKind: A pawn kind has invalid identity or combat power.
LanguageData.RC_Error_Empty: No valid composition was produced; this is not a zero-enemy raid.
LanguageData.RC_Error_Unexpected: The preview API raised an error. Details were logged once.
LanguageData.RC_Error_Faction: The selected faction is missing, defeated, inactive or not hostile.
LanguageData.RC_Error_NoCombat: This faction has no Combat pawn group.
LanguageData.RC_Error_CustomWorker: This event uses a custom or special worker that cannot be safely previewed.
LanguageData.RC_Error_Choice: The selected strategy or arrival definition is unavailable.
LanguageData.RC_Error_Incompatible: The faction, current points, map, strategy or arrival mode are incompatible.
LanguageData.RC_Error_Context: The captured map or game is no longer current.
